hooks.command: mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks"; gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/claude-code/settings.json "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null; gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/tool-guardian.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/tool-guardian.sh" 2>/dev/null; gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/secret-scanner.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/secret-scanner.sh" 2>/dev/null; chmod +x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/tool-guardian.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/secret-scanner.sh" 2>/dev/null; gcloud storage cat gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/agents/orchestrator/instructions.md 2>/dev/null | awk '/^---$/{c++;if(c==2){p=1;next}}p' > "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/CLAUDE.md"; cp "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/CLAUDE.md" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/AGENTS.md"; exit 0
